notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting(7)': Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers, Rendezvous Point, Kiffex (the Hidden Base indicator), Heading For The Medical Frigate, Insurrection, Staging Areas and Squadron Assignments; they count toward the 60. Several Effects start and none is named as the starting Effect, so none is set.
Posted 'Hidden Base / Oh @#$%' dested the Hidden Base objective; the back is posted as a joke name for Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers (as in the author's The Most Desperate Imperials).
Posted '(Indicator) Kiffex' dested the Light Kiffex (Jabba's Palace), started as the Hidden Base indicator system.

Posted 'Dagobah' dested Dagobah (Light); 'Tatooine' the Light Premiere system; 'Tatooine Jabba's Palace' the Light Special Edition site; 'Tatooine Docking Bay' Tatooine: Docking Bay 94; 'Weapon Levitation' the Light Jabba's Palace interrupt.

Posted 'Rendezous Point' dested Rendezvous Point; 'Wedge Antillies' Wedge Antilles, Red Squadron Leader; 'Orrimarko' Orrimaarko; 'Millenium Falcon' Millennium Falcon; 'Punch It' Punch It!; 'Run, Luke Run' Run Luke, Run!.
The post says the deck went 13-3 in local tournament play (no named event).

Posted 'There is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement' is the Dark combo Effect and cannot be in a Light deck; it is printed as written (UNKNOWN). The Light counterpart would be Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice, but the post does not say so.
Not a repost of the author's 'Mains' (14584) of the day before: the lists differ.
